findings.finding: Coordination history has two substantiated phases before the current Levy listing: Lemercier with Todd2019–2021; Todd since2022, attested July2025. No appointment or end date for Levy/Todd transition found.
2020 minutes show CHEP based across CSO and CHSP and a scientific council broader than the host unit. This is dated institutional history, not a2026 organisation chart.

2020 minutes imply Paris extension began more than two years earlier. This imprecise recollection does not fix an earlier founding date; retain alongside current2019 collaboration/2022 establishment account.
2023 Sciences Po event labels Todd director of Cambridge centre; do not propagate without Cambridge verification. It is a malformed event-page paragraph, not an appointment notice.
CHEP publicly credits calendar, coordination and website functions, but employment, reporting lines, time allocation and current responsibility for agenda remain unverified.

Ivanna Cherchovych explicitly receives a CHEP-supported non-residential fellowship hosted at Lviv; this is a support relationship and not Paris residency. Award dates are not in the CHEP announcement.
